caption: The worked example's 3×3 patch gives Gx = 160 and Gy = 0, so |G| = 160 and θ = 0°: the gradient points along +x and the edge is vertical. Because 160 ≥ Thigh = 150, the pixel is strong and hysteresis keeps it.

spec.title: Sobel on the 3×3 patch
spec.aria: A downward flow from the 3×3 patch of 10s and 50s to Sobel values Gx equals 160 and Gy equals 0, then magnitude 160, direction 0 degrees, and the test 160 is at least 150, so the pixel is strong and kept.
